title: Conformational switching of tubulin provides the qubits

statements.text: Conformational switching of tubulin produces coupled electron-vibration qubits for microtubule quantum computation.
statements.scope: an earlier form of the proposal, withdrawn in the 2014 review according to Reimers et al.

sources.quote: Previously, Hameroff and Penrose had also proposed that conformational switching could produce coupled electron-vibration qubits but this claim is withdrawn in the current review.
